notes: engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/base.py:959 (representative-only unit gate; ids joined at base.py:996–1004) — in a duplicate group with equal values but different units (USD+EUR at the same instant), the R-F1 unit check tests only the `representative` occurrence (chosen by occurrence-id order, base.py:951): when the USD fact is representative the valued row's `source_occurrence_ids` cites the EUR-tagged duplicate as co-evidence with no typed absence for it, and which outcome occurs (valued vs `unit_mismatch`) hinges on id ordering. Demonstrated live (T3c vs T3c-clean). The emitted value itself is never wrong (both duplicates agree numerically; differing values across units hit the `unit_mismatch` conflict branch), so NOTE not DEFECT. Minimal fix: gate the whole `admitted` group (any non-equivalent unit → `unit_mismatch`) instead of the representative.

base.py:1883 (`_identity_tolerance`, used by the weighted sum at base.py:2081–2097 and rollforward at base.py:2127–2140) — tolerance is one unit of the coarsest stated `decimals`; a 6–7-line reconciliation or rollforward whose disclosed lines foot only within accumulated rounding (up to N×0.5 units, e.g. 3M for six decimals=-6 lines against a 1M tolerance) can FAIL an economically tied identity. Conservative direction (false-fail, never false-value). Minimal fix: tolerance = half the sum of operand rounding units (or Σ 0.5-unit) for multi-addend identities.

pk05_tax.py:201–209 (`_decimals_of` fallback) — a disclosed ETR tagged `decimals="INF"` (claims exactness) falls back to the value's own scale (0.2 → tolerance 0.1), so `etr_formula_vs_disclosed` can PASS a formula that contradicts an "exact" disclosed rate. Rare input (INF on a rate), display-only check. Minimal fix: treat INF as tolerance 0 (or the formula's 6-dp quantum).

engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/pk05_tax.py:26–36 / calculation_linkbase.py:8–12 — the FX-translation/acquisition UTP movement lines (three standard spellings) map to no catalogue field, so `utp_rollforward` fails on such filings instead of absorbing them; this is a declared, typed limit (the identity goes `not_evaluable`, never invents the line), recorded here because a domain consumer will meet it on real filings.

defects: engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/pk09_controls.py:302-305 — GOING_CONCERN_DOUBT carries no negation or conditionality guard, so "no substantial doubt about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern" (run A1) and a hypothetical "substantial doubt about our ability ... may arise" (run A2) both emit `going_concern_substantial_doubt: valued 'disclosed'`, and `_going_concern_vs_opinion` then corroborates the false positive with `pass` when the auditor's own negated sentence repeats the phrase (run A1b) — minimal fix: guard the pattern with the v5-style clause look-back idiom already used for material weakness (refuse a preceding no/not/never/free-of and a following may/might/could) and let guarded wording fall through to the valued `not_disclosed` absence or a typed miss, mirroring MATERIAL_WEAKNESS_IDENTIFIED lines 243-257.

engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/pk09_controls.py:135-153 (arms) + :669-697 (sentence-bounded resolver) via base.py:3149 single leftmost `search` — "Management determined that the internal control over financial reporting of Testco Acquired Inc was not effective as of the acquisition date" (the standard SEC-guidance exclusion wording the 2026-11-01 issuer-named-copula recall repair now matches) placed before management's period-end conclusion emits `icfr_management_conclusion: 'ineffective'` although management concluded effective (run B1; reversed order yields 'effective', run B1-reversed — the flip is purely leftmost-order) — minimal fix: extend the v7 period machinery to prefer (or require) a conclusion clause whose sentence's as-of date equals the period of report, or demote to a typed absence when the section holds both an effective and an ineffective full-phrase conclusion (the two-firm demotion at :1160-1221 is the model).

engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/pk09_controls.py:352-359 (material_weakness_present scoped ITEM9A-only) against :1086-1135 (`_apply_icfr_management_fallback` mints the conclusion from the Item-8 Management report) — with Management's report in Item 8 and Item 9A incorporating by reference, the envelope emits `icfr_management_conclusion: 'ineffective'` (span inside the Item-8 report) while `material_weakness_present: valued 'false'` is asserted over the Item 9A incorporation sentence alone and `remediation_span` is gated off (run D1b) — the issuer did disclose a material weakness in the primary document this envelope itself read; minimal fix: run the same MGMT_ICFR_REPORT fallback search for the weakness boolean in finalize (or refuse the confident false whenever the conclusion row was minted from outside Item 9A), keeping the stock typed absence on ambiguity.
notes: engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/pk09_controls.py:302-306 — auditor_opinion_fs has no "qualified" arm (name declares it); an except-for qualified opinion correctly stays typed-absent (run C1; existing test 12611) but is never valued — recall gap, honest refusal.

engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_pack_contract.py:522-576 vs base.py:3192-3196 — the enum-literal catalogue binding is emit-time only: with the digest restamped, validate_pack_result accepts `text_value='probably_fine'` (and arbitrary fraud-verdict text) on a valued enum row; PK09's finalize-hook rows bypass the A.4 gate and stay catalogue-clean today, but the contract alone does not forbid such an emission.

engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/base.py:3149 (case-sensitive compile) + pk09_controls.py:306 — GOING_CONCERN_PLAN matches only lowercase "management's plans"; sentence-initial "Management's plans to alleviate..." misses and the field takes `narrative_span_not_located` (run A3), while lowercase resolves (run A3b).

engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/pk09_controls.py:301,467-474 — critical_audit_matters is heading-presence + 512-char window; on a heading-only report the value is trailing boilerplate ("Description of the Matter /s/ Big Four & Co LLP February 24, 2026", run batch 4) — presence semantics fine, captured text noisy.

engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/base.py:743-752 — conclusion/opinion rows bind period=period_of_report regardless of the sentence's own as-of date: "effective as of December 31, 2024" in a 2026-06-30 filing emits period.end=2026-06-30 with no typed marker (run 4d); v7 reconciles dates for remediations only.

defects: engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/pk10_proxy.py:103-106 — the anchor arm `frequency of` is unqualified, so `_say_on_pay_frequency_value` resolves the say-on-pay frequency from any sentence containing "frequency of" plus a surviving cadence word: "The frequency of dividend increases was annual for three years." emits `say_on_pay_frequency='annual'` (span: "frequency of dividend increases was annual"), and "The frequency of committee meetings is annual." with no say-on-pay content anywhere emits `'annual'`; the wrong sentence also wins when it precedes the genuine one — a valued enum with a source that does not support it — minimal fix: qualify the arm to the vote context (e.g. `frequency of[^.]{0,80}?(?:say[- ]on[- ]pay|(?:executive )?compensation|advisory)`) or require the anchored sentence to name a vote/proposal.

engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/narrative.py:122 — `name` (bytes, from line 119) is compared against `_DROP_SUBTREE_TAGS` (a frozenset of `str`), so `b"ix:header" in {"script","style","ix:header"}` is always False and no subtree is ever dropped; PK10 output effect (run A6): a document-initial matched sentence is quoted as `text_value='Form 0000000099 2026-06-30 Adjusted EPS was not a selected performance measure for fiscal 2025 executive compensation.'` — the hidden header's CIK/context dates presented inside a disclosure quote, and sentence boundaries computed over header content — minimal fix: decode the tag name before the compare (`name_match.group(1).decode("ascii","ignore").lower()`) or store bytes literals in the drop set.
notes: engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/pk10_proxy.py:58 — the performance-measure pattern admits only "most important/selected performance measure"; common proxy phrasings ("key performance measures", "primary performance measure") resolve as the valued `not_disclosed`.

engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/pk10_proxy.py:59 — the independence pattern misses noun phrasings; "Each of the non-management directors meets the independence standards of the NYSE…" resolves as valued `not_disclosed` over a real disclosure (run A5).

engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/pk10_proxy.py:113-127 — a disclosed cadence outside the enum ("every four years", run A4) resolves `not_disclosed`; the frozen catalogue has no "disclosed-outside-enum" code, so the absence claim overstates.

engine/fundamental_forensics/specialist_packs/base.py:3204-3206 — sentence quotes truncate silently at `max_chars=1024` while `source_span` keeps the full sentence (run A7: 1024-char value over a 2412-byte span), with no truncation marker in the row.

defects: D1 (pk11_bank.py:209-214 with :916-930): `cet1_vs_minimum` is evaluated by the framework before `finalize_result` values `cet1_ratio_disclosed`/`regulatory_minimum_disclosed`, and it is never re-evaluated. The placeholder relation `left_lte_right` with left=CET1 ratio, right=minimum asserts CET1 ≤ minimum, which is inverted (base.py:1900-1901).

D2 (pk11_bank.py:628-629 and :644-646, rule text :750-760): `_resolve_disclosed` applies the entity-tier precedence across all instants ≤ por and only then takes the latest instant inside the winning tier. A consolidated prior-year cell therefore beats a period-end cell.
D3 (pk11_bank.py:385-411): `capital_ratio_arithmetic` compares `cet1_capital / risk_weighted_assets` with `cet1_ratio_disclosed` without checking that the date and the regulatory approach match.
D4 (pk11_bank.py:662-665 through :757-759): the lower-of-approaches rule is applied to `regulatory_minimum_disclosed` on its own. It should follow the approach of the chosen CET1 ratio.

D5 (pk11_bank.py:267-297 and :440): the rollforward opening is the latest allowance instant before por, while provision and write-offs are year-to-date flows. In a 10-Q the opening becomes a prior quarter end.
D6 (pk11_bank.py:598-602 and :820): ratio cells have no 0..1 range check, so `11.5` (a percent written as a number) is valued.
D7 (pk11_bank.py:170-176 with :379-380): `us-gaap:LoansAndLeasesReceivableNetReportedAmount` (net of the allowance) is an alias of `loans_held_for_investment`, the `acl_coverage` denominator.

defects: D1 (pk12_biotech.py:141-146 with base.py:631): `_cash_runway_quarters` divides opCF by 4 with no full-year duration check. A Q4-only opCF of -25 gives 32 quarters instead of 8 and the check passes. Fix: refuse unless the opCF duration is annual, with an existing typed code (`unit_mismatch` covers period basis).

D2 (pk12_biotech.py:317-319 with base.py:4008-4033): the capex probe has no unit or duration check. EUR capex gives 22.222222 (pass), shares give 0.000480, Q4-only capex gives 23.529412. Fix: capex must be USD with an annual duration, else the check is not_evaluable with `unit_mismatch` (or `missing_dependency` when absent).

D3 (pk12_biotech.py:300-304 and :343): the FCF month count appears only in a limitation string, capex has no provenance in the envelope, and evidence_field_ids omit capex. Contracts are frozen, so no new row: withhold the month count until it can be traced.
D4 (pk12_biotech.py:141-146 and :201-210): the runway's static assumptions are never stated. Fix: add a limitation stating the formula and assumptions whenever the runway row is valued.
